# `lean-head-v1` fixture — provenance

`delegate_preamble.txt` is a **verbatim** slice of the V1 lean head that
`model_performance-g7h3` measured on the Anthropic wire across 98 end-to-end
claude-opus-5 / S7-17 runs.

**Source of truth**
`openai-evals-team-ci/.amplifier/evaluation/probes/bji-lean-head/v1_tools.json`,
key `delegate`, everything before the literal `\n\nAvailable agents:\n`.

**Why only the preamble.** The agent catalog that follows that marker is
appended by `tool-delegate` at runtime from whichever bundle is composed. It is
not repo source, it differs per bundle, and it is explicitly out of scope for
`model_performance-zc6t`.

| | chars |
|---|---|
| stock preamble (pre-change) | 1,190 |
| **V1 lean preamble (this file)** | **938** |
| saved | 252 |
| (out of scope) stock catalog | 12,904 |

**Do not edit this file to make a test pass.** It is the external reference the
shipped text is compared against; editing it to match a drifted implementation
removes the only thing the pin was protecting. If the preamble must genuinely
change, that is a new head — re-measure, or record the deviation in
`docs/lanes/zc6t-lean-head-ship/DONE-NOTE.md` and say why.
